input.prompt: Instrumental only, no vocals. Playful candy-forest music with a little spooky mischief for a 3D adventure game level made of gingerbread and sweets. Bouncy pizzicato strings, glockenspiel and music-box twinkles, a cheeky staccato bassoon melody, tiptoeing clarinet, woodblock and triangle, a touch of harpsichord, with occasional minor-key turns like a sweet but slightly sinister fairy-tale cottage. About 116 BPM, steady, no ending, loop-friendly game background music.
